passages.label: Mart. 6.1.1
passages.text: Sextus mittitur hic tibi libellus,

passages.label: Mart. 6.1.2
passages.text: In primis mihi care Martialis:

passages.label: Mart. 6.1.3
passages.text: Quem si terseris aure diligenti,

passages.label: Mart. 6.1.4
passages.text: Audebit minus anxius tremensque

passages.label: Mart. 6.1.5
passages.text: Magnas Caesaris in manus venire.

passages.label: Mart. 6.2.1
passages.text: Lusus erat sacrae conubia fallere taedae,

passages.label: Mart. 6.2.2
passages.text: Lusus et inmeritos execuisse mares.

passages.label: Mart. 6.2.3
passages.text: Utraque tu prohibes, Caesar, populisque futuris

passages.label: Mart. 6.2.4
passages.text: Succurris, nasci quos sine fraude iubes.

passages.label: Mart. 6.2.5
passages.text: Nec spado iam nec moechus erit te praeside quisquam:

passages.label: Mart. 6.2.6
passages.text: At prius—o mores!—et spado moechus erat.

passages.label: Mart. 6.3.1
passages.text: Nascere Dardanio promissum nomen Iulo,

passages.label: Mart. 6.3.2
passages.text: Vera deu=m suboles; nascere, magne puer:

passages.label: Mart. 6.3.3
passages.text: Cui pater aeternas post saecula tradat habenas,

passages.label: Mart. 6.3.4
passages.text: Quique regas orbem cum seniore senex.

passages.label: Mart. 6.3.5
passages.text: Ipsa tibi niveo trahet aurea pollice fila

passages.label: Mart. 6.3.6
passages.text: Et totam Phrixi Iulia nebit ovem.

passages.label: Mart. 6.4.1
passages.text: Censor maxime principumque princeps,

passages.label: Mart. 6.4.2
passages.text: Cum tot iam tibi debeat triumphos,

passages.label: Mart. 6.4.3
passages.text: Tot nascentia templa, tot renata,

passages.label: Mart. 6.4.4
passages.text: Tot spectacula, tot deos, tot urbes:

passages.label: Mart. 6.4.5
passages.text: Plus debet tibi Roma, quod pudica est.

passages.label: Mart. 6.5.1
passages.text: Rustica mercatus multis sum praedia nummis:

passages.label: Mart. 6.5.2
passages.text: Mutua des centum, Caeciliane, rogo.

passages.label: Mart. 6.5.3
passages.text: Nil mihi respondes? Tacitum te dicere credo

passages.label: Mart. 6.5.4
passages.text: 'Non reddes': ideo, Caeciliane, rogo.

passages.label: Mart. 6.6.1
passages.text: Comoedi tres sunt, sed amat tua Paula, Luperce,

passages.label: Mart. 6.6.2
passages.text: Quattuor: et κωφὸν Paula πρόσωπον amat.

passages.label: Mart. 6.7.1
passages.text: Iulia lex populis ex quo, Faustine, renata est

passages.label: Mart. 6.7.2
passages.text: Atque intrare domos iussa Pudicitia est,

passages.label: Mart. 6.7.3
passages.text: Aut minus aut certe non plus tricesima lux est,

passages.label: Mart. 6.7.4
passages.text: Et nubit decimo iam Telesilla viro.

passages.label: Mart. 6.7.5
passages.text: Quae nubit totiens, non nubit: adultera lege est.

passages.label: Mart. 6.7.6
passages.text: Offendor moecha simpliciore minus.

passages.label: Mart. 6.8.1
passages.text: Praetores duo, quattuor tribuni,

passages.label: Mart. 6.8.2
passages.text: Septem causidici, decem poetae

passages.label: Mart. 6.8.3
passages.text: Cuiusdam modo nuptias petebant

passages.label: Mart. 6.8.4
passages.text: A quodam sene. Non moratus ille

passages.label: Mart. 6.8.5
passages.text: Praeconi dedit Eulogo puellam.

passages.label: Mart. 6.8.6
passages.text: Dic, numquid fatue, Severe, fecit?

passages.label: Mart. 6.9.1
passages.text: In Pompeiano dormis, Laevine, theatro:

passages.label: Mart. 6.9.2
passages.text: Et quereris, si te suscitat Oceanus?

passages.label: Mart. 6.10.1
passages.text: Pauca Iovem nuper cum milia forte rogarem,

passages.label: Mart. 6.10.2
passages.text: 'Ille dabit' dixit 'qui mihi templa dedit.'

passages.label: Mart. 6.10.3
passages.text: Templa quidem dedit ille Iovi, sed milia nobis

passages.label: Mart. 6.10.4
passages.text: Nulla dedit: pudet, a, pauca rogasse Iovem

passages.label: Mart. 6.10.5
passages.text: At quam non tetricus, quam nulla nubilus ira,

passages.label: Mart. 6.10.6
passages.text: Quam placido nostras legerat ore preces!

passages.label: Mart. 6.10.7
passages.text: Talis supplicibus tribuit diademata Dacis

passages.label: Mart. 6.10.8
passages.text: Et Capitolinas itque reditque vias.

passages.label: Mart. 6.10.9
passages.text: Dic, precor, o nostri dic conscia virgo Tonantis,

passages.label: Mart. 6.10.10
passages.text: Si negat hoc vultu, quo solet ergo dare?

passages.label: Mart. 6.10.11
passages.text: Sic ego: sic breviter posita mihi Gorgone Pallas:

passages.label: Mart. 6.10.12
passages.text: 'Quae nondum data sunt, stulte, negata putas?'

passages.label: Mart. 6.11.1
passages.text: Quod non sit Pylades hoc tempore, non sit Orestes,

passages.label: Mart. 6.11.2
passages.text: Miraris? Pylades, Marce, bibebat idem,

passages.label: Mart. 6.11.3
passages.text: Nec melior panis turdusve dabatur Orestae,

passages.label: Mart. 6.11.4
passages.text: Sed par atque eadem cena duobus erat.

passages.label: Mart. 6.11.5
passages.text: Tu Lucrina voras, me pascit aquosa peloris:

passages.label: Mart. 6.11.6
passages.text: Non minus ingenua est et mihi, Marce, gula.

passages.label: Mart. 6.11.7
passages.text: Te Cadmea Tyros, me pinguis Gallia vestit:

passages.label: Mart. 6.11.8
passages.text: Vis te purpureum, Marce, sagatus amem?

passages.label: Mart. 6.11.9
passages.text: Ut praestem Pyladen, aliquis mihi praestet Oresten.

passages.label: Mart. 6.11.10
passages.text: Hoc non fit verbis, Marce: ut ameris, ama.

passages.label: Mart. 6.12.1
passages.text: Iurat capillos esse, quos emit, suos

passages.label: Mart. 6.12.2
passages.text: †Fabulla: numquid, Paule, peierat†?

passages.label: Mart. 6.13.1
passages.text: Quis te Phidiaco formatam, Iulia, caelo,

passages.label: Mart. 6.13.2
passages.text: Vel quis Palladiae non putet artis opus?

passages.label: Mart. 6.13.3
passages.text: Candida non tacita respondet imagine lygdos

passages.label: Mart. 6.13.4
passages.text: Et placido fulget vivus in ore decor.

passages.label: Mart. 6.13.5
passages.text: Ludit Acidalio, sed non manus aspera, nodo,

passages.label: Mart. 6.13.6
passages.text: Quem rapuit collo, parve Cupido, tuo.

passages.label: Mart. 6.13.7
passages.text: Ut Martis revocetur amor summique Tonantis,

passages.label: Mart. 6.13.8
passages.text: A te Iuno petat ceston et ipsa Venus.

passages.label: Mart. 6.14.1
passages.text: Versus scribere posse te disertos

passages.label: Mart. 6.14.2
passages.text: Adfirmas, Laberi: quid ergo non vis?

passages.label: Mart. 6.14.3
passages.text: Versus scribere qui potest disertos,

passages.label: Mart. 6.14.4
passages.text: Non scribat, Laberi: virum putabo.

passages.label: Mart. 6.15.1
passages.text: Dum Phaethontea formica vagatur in umbra,

passages.label: Mart. 6.15.2
passages.text: Inplicuit tenuem sucina gutta feram.

passages.label: Mart. 6.15.3
passages.text: Sic modo quae fuerat vita contempta manente,

passages.label: Mart. 6.15.4
passages.text: Funeribus facta est nunc pretiosa suis.

passages.label: Mart. 6.16.1
passages.text: Tu qui pene viros terres et falce cinaedos,

passages.label: Mart. 6.16.2
passages.text: Iugera sepositi pauca tuere soli.

passages.label: Mart. 6.16.3
passages.text: Sic tua non intrent vetuli pomaria fures,

passages.label: Mart. 6.16.4
passages.text: Sed puer et longis pulchra puella comis.

passages.label: Mart. 6.17.1
passages.text: Cinnam, Cinname, te iubes vocari.

passages.label: Mart. 6.17.2
passages.text: Non est hic, rogo, Cinna, barbarismus?

passages.label: Mart. 6.17.3
passages.text: Tu si Furius ante dictus esses,

passages.label: Mart. 6.17.4
passages.text: Fur ista ratione dicereris.

passages.label: Mart. 6.18.1
passages.text: Sancta Salonini terris requiescit Hiberis,

passages.label: Mart. 6.18.2
passages.text: Qua melior Stygias non videt umbra domos.

passages.label: Mart. 6.18.3
passages.text: Sed lugere nefas: nam qui te, Prisce, reliquit,

passages.label: Mart. 6.18.4
passages.text: Vivit qua voluit vivere parte magis.

passages.label: Mart. 6.19.1
passages.text: Non de vi neque caede nec veneno,

passages.label: Mart. 6.19.2
passages.text: Sed lis est mihi de tribus capellis:

passages.label: Mart. 6.19.3
passages.text: Vicini queror has abesse furto.

passages.label: Mart. 6.19.4
passages.text: Hoc iudex sibi postulat probari:

passages.label: Mart. 6.19.5
passages.text: Tu Cannas Mithridaticumque bellum

passages.label: Mart. 6.19.6
passages.text: Et periuria Punici furoris

passages.label: Mart. 6.19.7
passages.text: Et Sullas Mariosque Muciosque

passages.label: Mart. 6.19.8
passages.text: Magna voce sonas manuque tota.

passages.label: Mart. 6.19.9
passages.text: Iam dic, Postume, de tribus capellis.

passages.label: Mart. 6.20.1
passages.text: Mutua te centum sestertia, Phoebe, rogavi,

passages.label: Mart. 6.20.2
passages.text: Cum mihi dixisses 'exigis ergo nihil?'

passages.label: Mart. 6.20.3
passages.text: Inquiris, dubitas, cunctaris meque diebus

passages.label: Mart. 6.20.4
passages.text: Teque decem crucias: iam rogo, Phoebe, nega.

passages.label: Mart. 6.21.1
passages.text: Perpetuam Stellae dum iungit Ianthida vati

passages.label: Mart. 6.21.2
passages.text: Laeta Venus, dixit 'Plus dare non potui.'

passages.label: Mart. 6.21.3
passages.text: Haec coram domina; sed nequius illud in aurem:

passages.label: Mart. 6.21.4
passages.text: 'Tu ne quid pecces, exitiose, vide.

passages.label: Mart. 6.21.5
passages.text: Saepe ego lascivom Martem furibunda cecidi,

passages.label: Mart. 6.21.6
passages.text: Legitimos esset cum vagus ante toros.

passages.label: Mart. 6.21.7
passages.text: Sed postquam meus est, nulla me paelice laesit:

passages.label: Mart. 6.21.8
passages.text: Tam frugi Iuno vellet habere virum.'

passages.label: Mart. 6.21.9
passages.text: Dixit, et arcano percussit pectora loro.

passages.label: Mart. 6.21.10
passages.text: Plaga iuvat: sed tu iam, dea, caede deos.

passages.label: Mart. 6.22.1
passages.text: Quod nubis, Proculina, concubino

passages.label: Mart. 6.22.2
passages.text: Et, moechum modo, nunc facis maritum,

passages.label: Mart. 6.22.3
passages.text: Ne lex Iulia te notare possit:

passages.label: Mart. 6.22.4
passages.text: Non nubis, Proculina, sed fateris.

passages.label: Mart. 6.23.1
passages.text: Stare iubes nostrum semper tibi, Lesbia, penem:

passages.label: Mart. 6.23.2
passages.text: Crede mihi, non est mentula, quod digitus.

passages.label: Mart. 6.23.3
passages.text: Tu licet et manibus blandis et vocibus instes,

passages.label: Mart. 6.23.4
passages.text: Te contra facies imperiosa tua est.

passages.label: Mart. 6.24.1
passages.text: Nil lascivius est Charisiano:

passages.label: Mart. 6.24.2
passages.text: Saturnalibus ambulat togatus.

passages.label: Mart. 6.25.1
passages.text: Marcelline, boni suboles sincera parentis,

passages.label: Mart. 6.25.2
passages.text: Horrida Parrhasio quem tegit ursa iugo,

passages.label: Mart. 6.25.3
passages.text: Ille vetus pro te patriusque quid optet amicus,

passages.label: Mart. 6.25.4
passages.text: Accipe et haec memori pectore vota tene:

passages.label: Mart. 6.25.5
passages.text: Cauta sit ut virtus, nec te temerarius ardor

passages.label: Mart. 6.25.6
passages.text: In medios enses saevaque tela ferat.

passages.label: Mart. 6.25.7
passages.text: Bella velint Martemque ferum rationis egentes,

passages.label: Mart. 6.25.8
passages.text: Tu potes et patris miles et esse ducis.

passages.label: Mart. 6.26.1
passages.text: Periclitatur capite Sotades noster.

passages.label: Mart. 6.26.2
passages.text: Reum putatis esse Sotaden? non est.

passages.label: Mart. 6.26.3
passages.text: Arrigere desi=t posse Sotades: lingit.

passages.label: Mart. 6.27.1
passages.text: Bis vicine Nepos—nam tu quoque proxima Florae

passages.label: Mart. 6.27.2
passages.text: Incolis et veteres tu quoque Ficelias—

passages.label: Mart. 6.27.3
passages.text: Est tibi, quae patria signatur imagine voltus,

passages.label: Mart. 6.27.4
passages.text: Testis maternae nata pudicitiae.

passages.label: Mart. 6.27.5
passages.text: Tu tamen annoso nimium ne parce Falerno,

passages.label: Mart. 6.27.6
passages.text: Et potius plenos aere relinque cados.

passages.label: Mart. 6.27.7
passages.text: Sit pia, sit locuples, sed potet filia mustum:

passages.label: Mart. 6.27.8
passages.text: Amphora cum domina nunc nova fiet anus.

passages.label: Mart. 6.27.9
passages.text: Caecuba non solos vindemia nutriat orbos:

passages.label: Mart. 6.27.10
passages.text: Possunt et patres vivere, crede mihi.

passages.label: Mart. 6.28.1
passages.text: Libertus Melioris ille notus,

passages.label: Mart. 6.28.2
passages.text: Tota qui cecidit dolente Roma,

passages.label: Mart. 6.28.3
passages.text: Cari deliciae breves patroni,

passages.label: Mart. 6.28.4
passages.text: Hoc sub marmore Glaucias humatus

passages.label: Mart. 6.28.5
passages.text: Iuncto Flaminiae iacet sepulchro:

passages.label: Mart. 6.28.6
passages.text: Castus moribus, integer pudore,

passages.label: Mart. 6.28.7
passages.text: Velox ingenio, decore felix.

passages.label: Mart. 6.28.8
passages.text: Bis senis modo messibus peractis

passages.label: Mart. 6.28.9
passages.text: Vix unum puer adplicabat annum.

passages.label: Mart. 6.28.10
passages.text: Qui fles talia, nil fleas, viator.

passages.label: Mart. 6.29.1
passages.text: Non de plebe domus nec avarae verna catastae,

passages.label: Mart. 6.29.2
passages.text: Sed domini sancto dignus amore puer,

passages.label: Mart. 6.29.3
passages.text: Munera cum posset nondum sentire patroni,

passages.label: Mart. 6.29.4
passages.text: Glaucia libertus iam Melioris erat.

passages.label: Mart. 6.29.5
passages.text: Moribus hoc formaeque datum: quis blandior illo?

passages.label: Mart. 6.29.6
passages.text: Aut quis Apollineo pulchrior ore fuit?

passages.label: Mart. 6.29.7
passages.text: Inmodicis brevis est aetas et rara senectus.

passages.label: Mart. 6.29.8
passages.text: Quidquid ames, cupias non placuisse nimis.

passages.label: Mart. 6.30.1
passages.text: Sex sestertia si statim dedisses,

passages.label: Mart. 6.30.2
passages.text: Cum dixti mihi 'Sume, tolle, dono',

passages.label: Mart. 6.30.3
passages.text: Deberem tibi, Paete, pro ducentis.

passages.label: Mart. 6.30.4
passages.text: At nunc cum dederis diu moratus,

passages.label: Mart. 6.30.5
passages.text: Post septem, puto, vel novem Kalendas,

passages.label: Mart. 6.30.6
passages.text: Vis dicam tibi veriora veris?

passages.label: Mart. 6.30.7
passages.text: Sex sestertia, Paete, perdidisti.

passages.label: Mart. 6.31.1
passages.text: Uxorem, Charideme, tuam scis ipse sinisque

passages.label: Mart. 6.31.2
passages.text: A medico futui: vis sine febre mori.

passages.label: Mart. 6.32.1
passages.text: Cum dubitaret adhuc belli civilis Enyo

passages.label: Mart. 6.32.2
passages.text: Forsitan et posset vincere mollis Otho,

passages.label: Mart. 6.32.3
passages.text: Damnavit multo staturum sanguine Martem

passages.label: Mart. 6.32.4
passages.text: Et fodit certa pectora tota manu.

passages.label: Mart. 6.32.5
passages.text: Sit Cato, dum vivit, sane vel Caesare maior:

passages.label: Mart. 6.32.6
passages.text: Dum moritur, numquid maior Othone fuit?

passages.label: Mart. 6.33.1
passages.text: Nil miserabilius, Matho, pedicone Sabello

passages.label: Mart. 6.33.2
passages.text: Vidisti, quo nil laetius ante fuit.

passages.label: Mart. 6.33.3
passages.text: Furta, fugae, mortes servorum, incendia, luctus

passages.label: Mart. 6.33.4
passages.text: Adfligunt hominem, iam miser et futuit.

passages.label: Mart. 6.34.1
passages.text: Basia da nobis, Diadumene, pressa. 'Quot?' inquis.

passages.label: Mart. 6.34.2
passages.text: Oceani fluctus me numerare iubes

passages.label: Mart. 6.34.3
passages.text: Et maris Aegaei sparsas per litora conchas

passages.label: Mart. 6.34.4
passages.text: Et quae Cecropio monte vagantur apes,

passages.label: Mart. 6.34.5
passages.text: Quaeque sonant pleno vocesque manusque theatro,

passages.label: Mart. 6.34.6
passages.text: Cum populus subiti Caesaris ora videt.

passages.label: Mart. 6.34.7
passages.text: Nolo quot arguto dedit exorata Catullo

passages.label: Mart. 6.34.8
passages.text: Lesbia: pauca cupit, qui numerare potest.

passages.label: Mart. 6.35.1
passages.text: Septem clepsydras magna tibi voce petenti

passages.label: Mart. 6.35.2
passages.text: Arbiter invitus, Caeciliane, dedit.

passages.label: Mart. 6.35.3
passages.text: At tu multa diu dicis vitreisque tepentem

passages.label: Mart. 6.35.4
passages.text: Ampullis potas semisupinus aquam.

passages.label: Mart. 6.35.5
passages.text: Ut tandem saties vocemque sitimque, rogamus,

passages.label: Mart. 6.35.6
passages.text: Iam de clepsydra, Caeciliane, bibas.

passages.label: Mart. 6.36.1
passages.text: Mentula tam magna est, quantus tibi, Papyle, nasus,

passages.label: Mart. 6.36.2
passages.text: Ut possis, quotiens arrigis, olfacere.

passages.label: Mart. 6.37.1
passages.text: Secti podicis usque ad umbilicum

passages.label: Mart. 6.37.2
passages.text: Nullas reliquias habet Charinus,

passages.label: Mart. 6.37.3
passages.text: Et prurit tamen usque ad umbilicum.

passages.label: Mart. 6.37.4
passages.text: O quanta scabie miser laborat!

passages.label: Mart. 6.37.5
passages.text: Culum non habet, est tamen cinaedus.

passages.label: Mart. 6.38.1
passages.text: Aspicis, ut parvus nec adhuc trieteride plena

passages.label: Mart. 6.38.2
passages.text: Regulus auditum laudet et ipse patrem?

passages.label: Mart. 6.38.3
passages.text: Maternosque sinus viso genitore relinquat

passages.label: Mart. 6.38.4
passages.text: Et patrias laudes sentiat esse suas?

passages.label: Mart. 6.38.5
passages.text: Iam clamor centumque viri densumque corona

passages.label: Mart. 6.38.6
passages.text: Volgus et infanti Iulia tecta placent.

passages.label: Mart. 6.38.7
passages.text: Acris equi suboles magno sic pulvere gaudet,

passages.label: Mart. 6.38.8
passages.text: Sic vitulus molli proelia fronte cupit.

passages.label: Mart. 6.38.9
passages.text: Di, servate, precor, matri sua vota patrique,

passages.label: Mart. 6.38.10
passages.text: Audiat ut natum Regulus, illa duos.

passages.label: Mart. 6.39.1
passages.text: Pater ex Marulla, Cinna, factus es septem

passages.label: Mart. 6.39.2
passages.text: Non liberorum: namque nec tuus quisquam

passages.label: Mart. 6.39.3
passages.text: Nec est amici filiusve vicini,

passages.label: Mart. 6.39.4
passages.text: Sed in grabatis tegetibusque concepti

passages.label: Mart. 6.39.5
passages.text: Materna produnt capitibus suis furta.

passages.label: Mart. 6.39.6
passages.text: Hic, qui retorto crine Maurus incedit,

passages.label: Mart. 6.39.7
passages.text: Subolem fatetur esse se coci Santrae.

passages.label: Mart. 6.39.8
passages.text: At ille sima nare, turgidis labris

passages.label: Mart. 6.39.9
passages.text: Ipsa est imago Pannychi palaestritae.

passages.label: Mart. 6.39.10
passages.text: Pistoris esse tertium quis ignorat,

passages.label: Mart. 6.39.11
passages.text: Quicumque lippum novit et videt Damam?

passages.label: Mart. 6.39.12
passages.text: Quartus cinaeda fronte, candido voltu

passages.label: Mart. 6.39.13
passages.text: Ex concubino natus est tibi Lygdo:

passages.label: Mart. 6.39.14
passages.text: Percide, si vis, filium: nefas non est.

passages.label: Mart. 6.39.15
passages.text: Hunc vero acuto capite et auribus longis,

passages.label: Mart. 6.39.16
passages.text: Quae sic moventur, ut solent asellorum,

passages.label: Mart. 6.39.17
passages.text: Quis morionis filium negat Cyrtae?

passages.label: Mart. 6.39.18
passages.text: Duae sorores, illa nigra et haec rufa,

passages.label: Mart. 6.39.19
passages.text: Croti choraulae vilicique sunt Carpi.

passages.label: Mart. 6.39.20
passages.text: Iam Niobidarum grex tibi foret plenus,

passages.label: Mart. 6.39.21
passages.text: Si spado Coresus Dindymusque non esset.

passages.label: Mart. 6.40.1
passages.text: Femina praeferri potuit tibi nulla, Lycori:

passages.label: Mart. 6.40.2
passages.text: Praeferri Glycerae femina nulla potest.

passages.label: Mart. 6.40.3
passages.text: Haec erit hoc quod tu: tu non potes esse quod haec est

passages.label: Mart. 6.40.4
passages.text: Tempora quid faciunt! hanc volo, te volui.

passages.label: Mart. 6.41.1
passages.text: Qui recitat lana fauces et colla revinctus,

passages.label: Mart. 6.41.2
passages.text: Hic se posse loqui, posse tacere negat.

passages.label: Mart. 6.42.1
passages.text: Etrusci nisi thermulis lavaris,

passages.label: Mart. 6.42.2
passages.text: Inlotus morieris, Oppiane.

passages.label: Mart. 6.42.3
passages.text: Nullae sic tibi blandientur undae,

passages.label: Mart. 6.42.4
passages.text: Nec fontes Aponi rudes puellis,

passages.label: Mart. 6.42.5
passages.text: Non mollis Sinuessa fervidique

passages.label: Mart. 6.42.6
passages.text: Fluctus Passeris aut superbus Anxur,

passages.label: Mart. 6.42.7
passages.text: Non Phoebi vada principesque Baiae.

passages.label: Mart. 6.42.8
passages.text: Nusquam tam nitidum vacat serenum:

passages.label: Mart. 6.42.9
passages.text: Lux ipsa est ibi longior, diesque

passages.label: Mart. 6.42.10
passages.text: Nullo tardius a loco recedit.

passages.label: Mart. 6.42.11
passages.text: Illic Taygeti virent metalla

passages.label: Mart. 6.42.12
passages.text: Et certant vario decore saxa,

passages.label: Mart. 6.42.13
passages.text: Quae Phryx et Libys altius cecidit.

passages.label: Mart. 6.42.14
passages.text: Siccos pinguis onyx anhelat aestus

passages.label: Mart. 6.42.15
passages.text: Et flamma tenui calent ophitae:

passages.label: Mart. 6.42.16
passages.text: Ritus si placeant tibi Laconum,

passages.label: Mart. 6.42.17
passages.text: Contentus potes arido vapore

passages.label: Mart. 6.42.18
passages.text: Cruda Virgine Marciave mergi;

passages.label: Mart. 6.42.19
passages.text: Quae tam candida, tam serena lucet,

passages.label: Mart. 6.42.20
passages.text: Ut nullas ibi suspiceris undas

passages.label: Mart. 6.42.21
passages.text: Et credas vacuam nitere lygdon.

passages.label: Mart. 6.42.22
passages.text: Non adtendis, et aure me supina

passages.label: Mart. 6.42.23
passages.text: Iam dudum quasi neglegenter audis.

passages.label: Mart. 6.42.24
passages.text: Inlotus morieris, Oppiane.

passages.label: Mart. 6.43.1
passages.text: Dum tibi felices indulgent, Castrice, Baiae

passages.label: Mart. 6.43.2
passages.text: Canaque sulphureis nympha natatur aquis,

passages.label: Mart. 6.43.3
passages.text: Me Nomentani confirmant otia ruris

passages.label: Mart. 6.43.4
passages.text: Et casa iugeribus non onerosa suis.

passages.label: Mart. 6.43.5
passages.text: Hoc mihi Baiani soles mollisque Lucrinus,

passages.label: Mart. 6.43.6
passages.text: Hoc mihi sunt vestrae, Castrice, divitiae.

passages.label: Mart. 6.43.7
passages.text: Quondam laudatas quocumque libebat ad undas

passages.label: Mart. 6.43.8
passages.text: Currere nec longas pertimuisse vias,

passages.label: Mart. 6.43.9
passages.text: Nunc urbis vicina iuvant facilesque recessus,

passages.label: Mart. 6.43.10
passages.text: Et satis est, pigro si licet esse mihi.

passages.label: Mart. 6.44.1
passages.text: Festive credis te, Calliodore, iocari

passages.label: Mart. 6.44.2
passages.text: Et solum multo permaduisse sale.

passages.label: Mart. 6.44.3
passages.text: Omnibus adrides, dicteria dicis in omnis;

passages.label: Mart. 6.44.4
passages.text: Sic te convivam posse placere putas.

passages.label: Mart. 6.44.5
passages.text: At si ego non belle, sed vere dixero quiddam,

passages.label: Mart. 6.44.6
passages.text: Nemo propinabit, Calliodore, tibi.

passages.label: Mart. 6.45.1
passages.text: Lusistis, satis est: lascivi nubite cunni:

passages.label: Mart. 6.45.2
passages.text: Permissa est vobis non nisi casta Venus.

passages.label: Mart. 6.45.3
passages.text: Haec est casta Venus? nubit Laetoria Lygdo:

passages.label: Mart. 6.45.4
passages.text: Turpius uxor erit, quam modo moecha fuit.

passages.label: Mart. 6.46.1
passages.text: Vapulat adsidue veneti quadriga flagello,

passages.label: Mart. 6.46.2
passages.text: Nec currit: magnam rem, Catiane, facit.

passages.label: Mart. 6.47.1
passages.text: Nympha, mei Stellae quae fonte domestica puro

passages.label: Mart. 6.47.2
passages.text: Laberis et domini gemmea tecta subis,

passages.label: Mart. 6.47.3
passages.text: Sive Numae coniunx Triviae te misit ab antris,

passages.label: Mart. 6.47.4
passages.text: Sive Camenarum de grege nona venis:

passages.label: Mart. 6.47.5
passages.text: Exolvit votis hac se tibi virgine porca

passages.label: Mart. 6.47.6
passages.text: Marcus, furtivam quod bibit aeger aquam.

passages.label: Mart. 6.47.7
passages.text: Tu contenta meo iam crimine gaudia fontis

passages.label: Mart. 6.47.8
passages.text: Da secura tui: sit mihi sana sitis.

passages.label: Mart. 6.48.1
passages.text: Quod tam grande sophos clamat tibi turba togata,

passages.label: Mart. 6.48.2
passages.text: Non tu, Pomponi, cena diserta tua est.

passages.label: Mart. 6.49.1
passages.text: Non sum de fragili dolatus ulmo,

passages.label: Mart. 6.49.2
passages.text: Nec quae stat rigida supina vena,

passages.label: Mart. 6.49.3
passages.text: De ligno mihi quolibet columna est,

passages.label: Mart. 6.49.4
passages.text: Sed viva generata de cupressu:

passages.label: Mart. 6.49.5
passages.text: Quae nec saecula centiens peracta

passages.label: Mart. 6.49.6
passages.text: Nec longae cariem timet senectae.

passages.label: Mart. 6.49.7
passages.text: Hanc tu, quisquis es, o malus, timeto.

passages.label: Mart. 6.49.8
passages.text: Nam si vel minimos manu rapaci

passages.label: Mart. 6.49.9
passages.text: Hoc de palmite laeseris racemos,

passages.label: Mart. 6.49.10
passages.text: Nascetur, licet hoc velis negare,

passages.label: Mart. 6.49.11
passages.text: Inserta tibi ficus a cupressu.

passages.label: Mart. 6.50.1
passages.text: Cum coleret puros pauper Telesinus amicos,

passages.label: Mart. 6.50.2
passages.text: Errabat gelida sordidus in togula:

passages.label: Mart. 6.50.3
passages.text: Obscenos ex quo coepit curare cinaedos,

passages.label: Mart. 6.50.4
passages.text: Argentum, mensas, praedia solus emit.

passages.label: Mart. 6.50.5
passages.text: Vis fieri dives, Bithynice? conscius esto:

passages.label: Mart. 6.50.6
passages.text: Nil tibi vel minimum basia pura dabunt.

passages.label: Mart. 6.51.1
passages.text: Quod convivaris sine me tam saepe, Luperce,

passages.label: Mart. 6.51.2
passages.text: Inveni, noceam qua ratione tibi.

passages.label: Mart. 6.51.3
passages.text: Irascor: licet usque voces mittasque rogesque—

passages.label: Mart. 6.51.4
passages.text: 'Quid facies?' inquis. Quid faciam? veniam.

passages.label: Mart. 6.52.1
passages.text: Hoc iacet in tumulo raptus puerilibus annis

passages.label: Mart. 6.52.2
passages.text: Pantagathus, domini cura dolorque sui,

passages.label: Mart. 6.52.3
passages.text: Vix tangente vagos ferro resecare capillos

passages.label: Mart. 6.52.4
passages.text: Doctus et hirsutas excoluisse genas.

passages.label: Mart. 6.52.5
passages.text: Sis licet, ut debes, tellus, placata levisque,

passages.label: Mart. 6.52.6
passages.text: Artificis levior non potes esse manu.

passages.label: Mart. 6.53.1
passages.text: Lotus nobiscum est, hilaris cenavit, et idem

passages.label: Mart. 6.53.2
passages.text: Inventus mane est mortuus Andragoras.

passages.label: Mart. 6.53.3
passages.text: Tam subitae mortis causam, Faustine, requiris?

passages.label: Mart. 6.53.4
passages.text: In somnis medicum viderat Hermocraten.

passages.label: Mart. 6.54.1
passages.text: Tantos et tantas si dicere Sextilianum,

passages.label: Mart. 6.54.2
passages.text: Aule, vetes, iunget vix tria verba miser.

passages.label: Mart. 6.54.3
passages.text: 'Quid sibi vult?' inquis. Dicam, quid suspicer esse:

passages.label: Mart. 6.54.4
passages.text: Tantos et tantas Sextilianus amat.

passages.label: Mart. 6.55.1
passages.text: Quod semper casiaque cinnamoque

passages.label: Mart. 6.55.2
passages.text: Et nido niger alitis superbae

passages.label: Mart. 6.55.3
passages.text: Fragras plumbea Nicerotiana,

passages.label: Mart. 6.55.4
passages.text: Rides nos, Coracine, nil olentis:

passages.label: Mart. 6.55.5
passages.text: Malo, quam bene olere, nil olere.

passages.label: Mart. 6.56.1
passages.text: Quod tibi crura rigent saetis et pectora villis,

passages.label: Mart. 6.56.2
passages.text: Verba putas famae te, Charideme, dare?

passages.label: Mart. 6.56.3
passages.text: Extirpa, mihi crede, pilos de corpore toto

passages.label: Mart. 6.56.4
passages.text: Teque pilare tuas testificare natis.

passages.label: Mart. 6.56.5
passages.text: 'Quae ratio est?' inquis. Scis multos dicere multa:

passages.label: Mart. 6.56.6
passages.text: Fac pedicari te, Charideme, putent.

passages.label: Mart. 6.57.1
passages.text: Mentiris fictos unguento, Phoebe, capillos

passages.label: Mart. 6.57.2
passages.text: Et tegitur pictis sordida calva comis.

passages.label: Mart. 6.57.3
passages.text: Tonsorem capiti non est adhibere necesse:

passages.label: Mart. 6.57.4
passages.text: Radere te melius spongia, Phoebe, potest.

passages.label: Mart. 6.58.1
passages.text: Cernere Parrhasios dum te iuvat, Aule, triones

passages.label: Mart. 6.58.2
passages.text: Comminus et Getici sidera ferre poli,

passages.label: Mart. 6.58.3
passages.text: O quam paene tibi Stygias ego raptus ad undas

passages.label: Mart. 6.58.4
passages.text: Elysiae vidi nubila fusca plagae!

passages.label: Mart. 6.58.5
passages.text: Quamvis lassa, tuos quaerebant lumina vultus

passages.label: Mart. 6.58.6
passages.text: Atque erat in gelido plurimus ore Pudens.

passages.label: Mart. 6.58.7
passages.text: Si mihi lanificae ducunt non pulla sorores

passages.label: Mart. 6.58.8
passages.text: Stamina nec surdos vox habet ista deos,

passages.label: Mart. 6.58.9
passages.text: Sospite me sospes Latias reveheris ad urbes

passages.label: Mart. 6.58.10
passages.text: Et referes pili praemia clarus eques.

passages.label: Mart. 6.59.1
passages.text: Et dolet et queritur, sibi non contingere frigus,

passages.label: Mart. 6.59.2
passages.text: Propter sescentas Baccara gausapinas,

passages.label: Mart. 6.59.3
passages.text: Optat et obscuras luces ventosque nivesque,

passages.label: Mart. 6.59.4
passages.text: Odit et hibernos, si tepuere, dies.

passages.label: Mart. 6.59.5
passages.text: Quid fecere mali nostrae tibi, saeve, lacernae,

passages.label: Mart. 6.59.6
passages.text: Tollere de scapulis quas levis aura potest?

passages.label: Mart. 6.59.7
passages.text: Quanto simplicius, quanto est humanius illud,

passages.label: Mart. 6.59.8
passages.text: Mense vel Augusto sumere gausapinas!

passages.label: Mart. 6.60.1
passages.text: Laudat, amat, cantat nostros mea Roma libellos,

passages.label: Mart. 6.60.2
passages.text: Meque sinus omnes, me manus omnis habet.

passages.label: Mart. 6.60.3
passages.text: Ecce rubet quidam, pallet, stupet, oscitat, odit.

passages.label: Mart. 6.60.4
passages.text: Hoc volo: nunc nobis carmina nostra placent.

passages.label: Mart. 6.61.1
passages.text: Rem factam Pompullus habet, Faustine: legetur

passages.label: Mart. 6.61.2
passages.text: Et nomen toto sparget in orbe suum.

passages.label: Mart. 6.61.3
passages.text: 'Sic leve flavorum valeat genus Usiporum,

passages.label: Mart. 6.61.4
passages.text: Quisquis et Ausonium non amat imperium.'

passages.label: Mart. 6.61.5
passages.text: Ingeniosa tamen Pompulli scripta feruntur.

passages.label: Mart. 6.61.6
passages.text: 'Sed famae non est hoc, mihi crede, satis:

passages.label: Mart. 6.61.7
passages.text: Quam multi tineas pascunt blattasque diserti,

passages.label: Mart. 6.61.8
passages.text: Et redimunt soli carmina docta coci!

passages.label: Mart. 6.61.9
passages.text: Nescio quid plus est, quod donat saecula chartis:

passages.label: Mart. 6.61.10
passages.text: Victurus genium debet habere liber.'

passages.label: Mart. 6.62.1
passages.text: Amisit pater unicum Salanus:

passages.label: Mart. 6.62.2
passages.text: Cessas munera mittere, Oppiane?

passages.label: Mart. 6.62.3
passages.text: Heu, crudele nefas malaeque Parcae!

passages.label: Mart. 6.62.4
passages.text: Cuius vulturis hoc erit cadaver?

passages.label: Mart. 6.63.1
passages.text: Scis te captari, scis hunc qui captat, avarum,

passages.label: Mart. 6.63.2
passages.text: Et scis qui captat, quid, Mariane, velit.

passages.label: Mart. 6.63.3
passages.text: Tu tamen hunc tabulis heredem, stulte, supremis

passages.label: Mart. 6.63.4
passages.text: Scribis et esse tuo vis, furiose, loco.

passages.label: Mart. 6.63.5
passages.text: 'Munera magna tamen misit.' Sed misit in hamo;

passages.label: Mart. 6.63.6
passages.text: Et piscatorem piscis amare potest?

passages.label: Mart. 6.63.7
passages.text: Hicine deflebit vero tua fata dolore?

passages.label: Mart. 6.63.8
passages.text: Si cupis, ut ploret, des, Mariane, nihil.

passages.label: Mart. 6.64.1
passages.text: Cum sis nec rigida Fabiorum gente creatus

passages.label: Mart. 6.64.2
passages.text: Nec qualem Curio, dum prandia portat aranti,

passages.label: Mart. 6.64.3
passages.text: Hirsuta peperit rubicunda sub ilice coniunx,

passages.label: Mart. 6.64.4
passages.text: Sed patris ad speculum tonsi matrisque togatae

passages.label: Mart. 6.64.5
passages.text: Filius et possit sponsam te sponsa vocare:

passages.label: Mart. 6.64.6
passages.text: Emendare meos, quos novit fama, libellos

passages.label: Mart. 6.64.7
passages.text: Et tibi permittis felicis carpere nugas,—

passages.label: Mart. 6.64.8
passages.text: Has, inquam, nugas, quibus aurem advertere totam

passages.label: Mart. 6.64.9
passages.text: Non aspernantur proceres urbisque forique,

passages.label: Mart. 6.64.10
passages.text: Quas et perpetui dignantur scrinia Sili

passages.label: Mart. 6.64.11
passages.text: Et repetit totiens facundo Regulus ore,

passages.label: Mart. 6.64.12
passages.text: Quique videt propius magni certamina Circi

passages.label: Mart. 6.64.13
passages.text: Laudat Aventinae vicinus Sura Dianae,

passages.label: Mart. 6.64.14
passages.text: Ipse etiam tanto dominus sub pondere rerum

passages.label: Mart. 6.64.15
passages.text: Non dedignatur bis terque revolvere Caesar.

passages.label: Mart. 6.64.16
passages.text: Sed tibi plus mentis, tibi cor limante Minerva

passages.label: Mart. 6.64.17
passages.text: Acrius et tenues finxerunt pectus Athenae.

passages.label: Mart. 6.64.18
passages.text: Ne valeam, si non multo sapit altius illud,

passages.label: Mart. 6.64.19
passages.text: Quod cum panticibus laxis et cum pede grandi

passages.label: Mart. 6.64.20
passages.text: Et rubro pulmone vetus nasisque timendum

passages.label: Mart. 6.64.21
passages.text: Omnia crudelis lanius per compita portat.

passages.label: Mart. 6.64.22
passages.text: Audes praeterea, quos nullus noverit, in me

passages.label: Mart. 6.64.23
passages.text: Scribere versiculos miseras et perdere chartas.

passages.label: Mart. 6.64.24
passages.text: At si quid nostrae tibi bilis inusserit ardor,

passages.label: Mart. 6.64.25
passages.text: Vivet et haerebit totoque legetur in orbe,

passages.label: Mart. 6.64.26
passages.text: Stigmata nec vafra delebit Cinnamus arte.

passages.label: Mart. 6.64.27
passages.text: Sed miserere tui, rabido nec perditus ore

passages.label: Mart. 6.64.28
passages.text: Fumantem nasum vivi temptaveris ursi.

passages.label: Mart. 6.64.29
passages.text: Sit placidus licet et lambat digitosque manusque,

passages.label: Mart. 6.64.30
passages.text: Si dolor et bilis, si iusta coegerit ira,

passages.label: Mart. 6.64.31
passages.text: Ursus erit: vacua dentes in pelle fatiges

passages.label: Mart. 6.64.32
passages.text: Et tacitam quaeras, quam possis rodere, carnem.

passages.label: Mart. 6.65.1
passages.text: 'Hexametris epigramma facis' scio dicere Tuccam.

passages.label: Mart. 6.65.2
passages.text: Tucca, solet fieri, denique, Tucca, licet.

passages.label: Mart. 6.65.3
passages.text: 'Sed tamen hoc longum est.' Solet hoc quoque, Tucca, licetque:

passages.label: Mart. 6.65.4
passages.text: Si breviora probas, disticha sola legas.

passages.label: Mart. 6.65.5
passages.text: Conveniat nobis, ut fas epigrammata longa

passages.label: Mart. 6.65.6
passages.text: Sit transire tibi, scribere, Tucca, mihi.

passages.label: Mart. 6.66.1
passages.text: Famae non nimium bonae puellam,

passages.label: Mart. 6.66.2
passages.text: Quales in media sedent Subura,

passages.label: Mart. 6.66.3
passages.text: Vendebat modo praeco Gellianus.

passages.label: Mart. 6.66.4
passages.text: Parvo cum pretio diu liceret,

passages.label: Mart. 6.66.5
passages.text: Dum puram cupit adprobare cunctis,

passages.label: Mart. 6.66.6
passages.text: Adtraxit prope se manu negantem

passages.label: Mart. 6.66.7
passages.text: Et bis terque quaterque basiavit.

passages.label: Mart. 6.66.8
passages.text: Quid profecerit osculo, requiris?

passages.label: Mart. 6.66.9
passages.text: Sescentos modo qui dabat, negavit.

passages.label: Mart. 6.67.1
passages.text: Cur tantum eunuchos habeat tua Caelia, quaeris,

passages.label: Mart. 6.67.2
passages.text: Pannyche? volt futui Caelia nec parere.

passages.label: Mart. 6.68.1
passages.text: Flete nefas vestrum, sed toto flete Lucrino,

passages.label: Mart. 6.68.2
passages.text: Naides, et luctus sentiat ipsa Thetis.

passages.label: Mart. 6.68.3
passages.text: Inter Baianas raptus puer occidit undas

passages.label: Mart. 6.68.4
passages.text: Eutychos ille, tuum, Castrice, dulce latus.

passages.label: Mart. 6.68.5
passages.text: Hic tibi curarum socius blandumque levamen,

passages.label: Mart. 6.68.6
passages.text: Hic amor, hic nostri vatis Alexis erat.

passages.label: Mart. 6.68.7
passages.text: Numquid te vitreis nudum lasciva sub undis

passages.label: Mart. 6.68.8
passages.text: Vidit et Alcidae nympha remisit Hylan?

passages.label: Mart. 6.68.9
passages.text: An dea femineum iam neglegit Hermaphroditum

passages.label: Mart. 6.68.10
passages.text: Amplexu teneri sollicitata viri?

passages.label: Mart. 6.68.11
passages.text: Quidquid id est, subitae, quaecumque est causa rapinae,

passages.label: Mart. 6.68.12
passages.text: Sit, precor, et tellus mitis et unda tibi.

passages.label: Mart. 6.69.1
passages.text: Non miror, quod potat aquam tua Bassa, Catulle:

passages.label: Mart. 6.69.2
passages.text: Miror, quod Bassi filia potat aquam.

passages.label: Mart. 6.70.1
passages.text: Sexagesima, Marciane, messis

passages.label: Mart. 6.70.2
passages.text: Acta est et, puto, iam secunda Cottae,

passages.label: Mart. 6.70.3
passages.text: Nec se taedia lectuli calentis

passages.label: Mart. 6.70.4
passages.text: Expertum meminit die vel uno.

passages.label: Mart. 6.70.5
passages.text: Ostendit digitum, sed inpudicum,

passages.label: Mart. 6.70.6
passages.text: Alconti Dasioque Symmachoque.

passages.label: Mart. 6.70.7
passages.text: At nostri bene computentur anni

passages.label: Mart. 6.70.8
passages.text: Et quantum tetricae tulere febres

passages.label: Mart. 6.70.9
passages.text: Aut languor gravis aut mali dolores,

passages.label: Mart. 6.70.10
passages.text: A vita meliore separentur:

passages.label: Mart. 6.70.11
passages.text: Infantes sumus, et senes videmur.

passages.label: Mart. 6.70.12
passages.text: Aetatem Priamique Nestorisque

passages.label: Mart. 6.70.13
passages.text: Longam qui putat esse, Marciane,

passages.label: Mart. 6.70.14
passages.text: Multum decipiturque falliturque.

passages.label: Mart. 6.70.15
passages.text: Non est vivere, sed valere vita est.

passages.label: Mart. 6.71.1
passages.text: Edere lascivos ad Baetica crusmata gestus

passages.label: Mart. 6.71.2
passages.text: Et Gaditanis ludere docta modis,

passages.label: Mart. 6.71.3
passages.text: Tendere quae tremulum Pelian Hecubaeque maritum

passages.label: Mart. 6.71.4
passages.text: Posset ad Hectoreos sollicitare rogos,

passages.label: Mart. 6.71.5
passages.text: Urit et excruciat dominum Telethusa priorem:

passages.label: Mart. 6.71.6
passages.text: Vendidit ancillam, nunc redimit dominam.

passages.label: Mart. 6.72.1
passages.text: Fur notae nimium rapacitatis

passages.label: Mart. 6.72.2
passages.text: Conpilare Cilix volebat hortum,

passages.label: Mart. 6.72.3
passages.text: Ingenti sed erat, Fabulle, in horto

passages.label: Mart. 6.72.4
passages.text: Praeter marmoreum nihil Priapum.

passages.label: Mart. 6.72.5
passages.text: Dum non vult vacua manu redire,

passages.label: Mart. 6.72.6
passages.text: Ipsum subripuit Cilix Priapum.

passages.label: Mart. 6.73.1
passages.text: Non rudis indocta fecit me falce colonus:

passages.label: Mart. 6.73.2
passages.text: Dispensatoris nobile cernis opus.

passages.label: Mart. 6.73.3
passages.text: Nam Caeretani cultor ditissimus agri

passages.label: Mart. 6.73.4
passages.text: Hos Hilarus colles et iuga laeta tenet.

passages.label: Mart. 6.73.5
passages.text: Aspice, quam certo videar non ligneus ore

passages.label: Mart. 6.73.6
passages.text: Nec devota focis inguinis arma geram,

passages.label: Mart. 6.73.7
passages.text: Sed mihi perpetua numquam moritura cupresso

passages.label: Mart. 6.73.8
passages.text: Phidiaca rigeat mentula digna manu.

passages.label: Mart. 6.73.9
passages.text: Vicini, moneo, sanctum celebrate Priapum

passages.label: Mart. 6.73.10
passages.text: Et bis septenis parcite iugeribus.

passages.label: Mart. 6.74.1
passages.text: Medio recumbit imus ille qui lecto,

passages.label: Mart. 6.74.2
passages.text: Calvam trifilem semitatus unguento,

passages.label: Mart. 6.74.3
passages.text: Foditque tonsis ora laxa lentiscis,

passages.label: Mart. 6.74.4
passages.text: Mentitur, Aefulane: non habet dentes.

passages.label: Mart. 6.75.1
passages.text: Cum mittis turdumve mihi quadramve placentae,

passages.label: Mart. 6.75.2
passages.text: Sive femur leporis, sive quid his simile est,

passages.label: Mart. 6.75.3
passages.text: Buccellas misisse tuas te, Pontia, dicis.

passages.label: Mart. 6.75.4
passages.text: Has ego non mittam, Pontia, sed nec edam.

passages.label: Mart. 6.76.1
passages.text: Ille sacri lateris custos Martisque togati,

passages.label: Mart. 6.76.2
passages.text: Credita cui summi castra fuere ducis,

passages.label: Mart. 6.76.3
passages.text: Hic situs est Fuscus. Licet hoc, Fortuna, fateri:

passages.label: Mart. 6.76.4
passages.text: Non timet hostiles iam lapis iste minas;

passages.label: Mart. 6.76.5
passages.text: Grande iugum domita Dacus cervice recepit,

passages.label: Mart. 6.76.6
passages.text: Et famulum victrix possidet umbra nemus.

passages.label: Mart. 6.77.1
passages.text: Cum sis tam pauper, quam nec miserabilis Iros,

passages.label: Mart. 6.77.2
passages.text: Tam iuvenis, quam nec Parthenopaeus erat,

passages.label: Mart. 6.77.3
passages.text: Tam fortis, quam nec, cum vinceret, Artemidorus,

passages.label: Mart. 6.77.4
passages.text: Quid te Cappadocum sex onus esse iuvat?

passages.label: Mart. 6.77.5
passages.text: Rideris multoque magis traduceris, Afer,

passages.label: Mart. 6.77.6
passages.text: Quam nudus medio si spatiere foro.

passages.label: Mart. 6.77.7
passages.text: Non aliter monstratur Atlans cum compare ginno

passages.label: Mart. 6.77.8
passages.text: Quaeque vehit similem belua nigra Libyn.

passages.label: Mart. 6.77.9
passages.text: Invidiosa tibi quam sit lectica, requiris?

passages.label: Mart. 6.77.10
passages.text: Non debes ferri mortuus hexaphoro.

passages.label: Mart. 6.78.1
passages.text: Potor nobilis, Aule, lumine uno

passages.label: Mart. 6.78.2
passages.text: Luscus Phryx erat alteroque lippus.

passages.label: Mart. 6.78.3
passages.text: Huic Heras medicus 'Bibas caveto:

passages.label: Mart. 6.78.4
passages.text: Vinum si biberis, nihil videbis.'

passages.label: Mart. 6.78.5
passages.text: Ridens Phryx oculo 'Valebis' inquit.

passages.label: Mart. 6.78.6
passages.text: Misceri sibi protinus deunces,

passages.label: Mart. 6.78.7
passages.text: Sed crebros iubet. Exitum requiris?

passages.label: Mart. 6.78.8
passages.text: Vinum Phryx, oculus bibit venenum.

passages.label: Mart. 6.79.1
passages.text: Tristis es et felix. Sciat hoc Fortuna caveto:

passages.label: Mart. 6.79.2
passages.text: Ingratum dicet te, Lupe, si scierit.

passages.label: Mart. 6.80.1
passages.text: Ut nova dona tibi, Caesar, Nilotica tellus

passages.label: Mart. 6.80.2
passages.text: Miserat hibernas ambitiosa rosas.

passages.label: Mart. 6.80.3
passages.text: Navita derisit Pharios Memphiticus hortos,

passages.label: Mart. 6.80.4
passages.text: Urbis ut intravit limina prima tuae:

passages.label: Mart. 6.80.5
passages.text: Tantus veris honos et odorae gratia Florae,

passages.label: Mart. 6.80.6
passages.text: Tantaque Paestani gloria ruris erat;

passages.label: Mart. 6.80.7
passages.text: Sic quacumque vagus gressumque oculosque ferebat,

passages.label: Mart. 6.80.8
passages.text: Tonsilibus sertis omne rubebat iter.

passages.label: Mart. 6.80.9
passages.text: At tu Romanae iussus iam cedere brumae,

passages.label: Mart. 6.80.10
passages.text: Mitte tuas messes, accipe, Nile, rosas.

passages.label: Mart. 6.81.1
passages.text: Iratus tamquam populo, Charideme, lavaris:

passages.label: Mart. 6.81.2
passages.text: Inguina sic toto subluis in solio.

passages.label: Mart. 6.81.3
passages.text: Nec caput hic vellem sic te, Charideme, lavare.

passages.label: Mart. 6.81.4
passages.text: Et caput, ecce, lavas: inguina malo laves.

passages.label: Mart. 6.82.1
passages.text: Quidam me modo, Rufe, diligenter

passages.label: Mart. 6.82.2
passages.text: Inspectum, velut emptor aut lanista,

passages.label: Mart. 6.82.3
passages.text: Cum vultu digitoque subnotasset,

passages.label: Mart. 6.82.4
passages.text: 'Tune es, tune' ait 'ille Martialis,

passages.label: Mart. 6.82.5
passages.text: Cuius nequitias iocosque novit,

passages.label: Mart. 6.82.6
passages.text: Aurem qui modo non habet Batavam?'

passages.label: Mart. 6.82.7
passages.text: Subrisi modice, levique nutu

passages.label: Mart. 6.82.8
passages.text: Me quem dixerat esse non negavi.

passages.label: Mart. 6.82.9
passages.text: 'Cur ergo' inquit 'habes malas lacernas?'

passages.label: Mart. 6.82.10
passages.text: Respondi: 'quia sum malus poeta'.

passages.label: Mart. 6.82.11
passages.text: Hoc ne saepius accidat poetae,

passages.label: Mart. 6.82.12
passages.text: Mittas, Rufe, mihi bonas lacernas.

passages.label: Mart. 6.83.1
passages.text: Quantum sollicito fortuna parentis Etrusco,

passages.label: Mart. 6.83.2
passages.text: Tantum, summe ducum, debet uterque tibi.

passages.label: Mart. 6.83.3
passages.text: Nam tu missa tua revocasti fulmina dextra:

passages.label: Mart. 6.83.4
passages.text: Hos cuperem mores ignibus esse Iovis;

passages.label: Mart. 6.83.5
passages.text: Si tua sit summo, Caesar, natura Tonanti,

passages.label: Mart. 6.83.6
passages.text: Utetur toto fulmine rara manus.

passages.label: Mart. 6.83.7
passages.text: Muneris hoc utrumque tui testatur Etruscus,

passages.label: Mart. 6.83.8
passages.text: Esse quod et comiti contigit et reduci.

passages.label: Mart. 6.84.1
passages.text: Octaphoro sanus portatur, Avite, Philippus.

passages.label: Mart. 6.84.2
passages.text: Hunc tu si sanum credis, Avite, furis.

passages.label: Mart. 6.85.1
passages.text: Editur en sextus sine te mihi, Rufe Camoni,

passages.label: Mart. 6.85.2
passages.text: Nec te lectorem sperat, amice, liber:

passages.label: Mart. 6.85.3
passages.text: Impia Cappadocum tellus et numine laevo

passages.label: Mart. 6.85.4
passages.text: Visa tibi cineres reddit et ossa patri.

passages.label: Mart. 6.85.5
passages.text: Funde tuo lacrimas orbata Bononia Rufo,

passages.label: Mart. 6.85.6
passages.text: Et resonet tota planctus in Aemilia:

passages.label: Mart. 6.85.7
passages.text: Heu qualis pietas, heu quam brevis occidit aetas!

passages.label: Mart. 6.85.8
passages.text: Viderat Alphei praemia quinta modo.

passages.label: Mart. 6.85.9
passages.text: Pectore tu memori nostros evolvere lusus,

passages.label: Mart. 6.85.10
passages.text: Tu solitus totos, Rufe, tenere iocos,

passages.label: Mart. 6.85.11
passages.text: Accipe cum fletu maesti breve carmen amici

passages.label: Mart. 6.85.12
passages.text: Atque haec absentis tura fuisse puta.

passages.label: Mart. 6.86.1
passages.text: Setinum dominaeque nives densique trientes.

passages.label: Mart. 6.86.2
passages.text: Quando ego vos medico non prohibente bibam?

passages.label: Mart. 6.86.3
passages.text: Stultus et ingratus nec tanto munere dignus,

passages.label: Mart. 6.86.4
passages.text: Qui mavult heres divitis esse Midae.

passages.label: Mart. 6.86.5
passages.text: Possideat Libycas messis Hermumque Tagumque,

passages.label: Mart. 6.86.6
passages.text: Et potet caldam, qui mihi livet, aquam.

passages.label: Mart. 6.87.1
passages.text: Di tibi dent et tu, Caesar, quaecumque mereris:

passages.label: Mart. 6.87.2
passages.text: Di mihi dent et tu, quae volo, si merui.

passages.label: Mart. 6.88.1
passages.text: Mane salutavi vero te nomine casu,

passages.label: Mart. 6.88.2
passages.text: Nec dixi dominum, Caeciliane, meum.

passages.label: Mart. 6.88.3
passages.text: Quanti libertas constet mihi tanta, requiris?

passages.label: Mart. 6.88.4
passages.text: Centum quadrantes abstulit illa mihi.

passages.label: Mart. 6.89.1
passages.text: Cum peteret seram media iam nocte matellam

passages.label: Mart. 6.89.2
passages.text: Arguto madidus pollice Panaretus,

passages.label: Mart. 6.89.3
passages.text: Spoletina data est, sed quam siccaverat ipse,

passages.label: Mart. 6.89.4
passages.text: Nec fuerat soli tota lagona satis.

passages.label: Mart. 6.89.5
passages.text: Ille fide summa testae sua vina remensus

passages.label: Mart. 6.89.6
passages.text: Reddidit oenophori pondera plena sui.

passages.label: Mart. 6.89.7
passages.text: Miraris, quantum biberat, cepisse lagonam?

passages.label: Mart. 6.89.8
passages.text: Desine mirari, Rufe: merum biberat.

passages.label: Mart. 6.90.1
passages.text: Moechum Gellia non habet nisi unum.

passages.label: Mart. 6.90.2
passages.text: Turpe est hoc magis: uxor est duorum.

passages.label: Mart. 6.91.1
passages.text: Sancta ducis summi prohibet censura vetatque

passages.label: Mart. 6.91.2
passages.text: Moechari. Gaude, Zoile, non futuis.

passages.label: Mart. 6.92.1
passages.text: Caelatus tibi cum sit, Anniane,

passages.label: Mart. 6.92.2
passages.text: Serpens in patera Myronos arte,

passages.label: Mart. 6.92.3
passages.text: Vaticana bibis: bibis venenum.

passages.label: Mart. 6.93.1
passages.text: Tam male Thais olet, quam non fullonis avari

passages.label: Mart. 6.93.2
passages.text: Testa vetus, media sed modo fracta via,

passages.label: Mart. 6.93.3
passages.text: Non ab amore recens hircus, non ora leonis,

passages.label: Mart. 6.93.4
passages.text: Non detracta cani transtiberina cutis,

passages.label: Mart. 6.93.5
passages.text: Pullus abortivo nec cum putrescit in ovo,

passages.label: Mart. 6.93.6
passages.text: Amphora corrupto nec vitiata garo.

passages.label: Mart. 6.93.7
passages.text: Virus ut hoc alio fallax permutet odore,

passages.label: Mart. 6.93.8
passages.text: Deposita quotiens balnea veste petit,

passages.label: Mart. 6.93.9
passages.text: Psilothro viret aut acida latet oblita creta

passages.label: Mart. 6.93.10
passages.text: Aut tegitur pingui terque quaterque faba.

passages.label: Mart. 6.93.11
passages.text: Cum bene se tutam per fraudes mille putavit,

passages.label: Mart. 6.93.12
passages.text: Omnia cum fecit, Thaida Thais olet.

passages.label: Mart. 6.94.1
passages.text: Ponuntur semper chrysendeta Calpetano

passages.label: Mart. 6.94.2
passages.text: Sive foris seu cum cenat in urbe domi.

passages.label: Mart. 6.94.3
passages.text: Sic etiam in stabulo semper, sic cenat in agro.

passages.label: Mart. 6.94.4
passages.text: Non habet ergo aliud? Non habet immo suum.
